Game Overview

In Alien Hunters, the core idea is straightforward: embark on an electrifying hunt as an alien slayer armed with a light dagger. Navigate through 140 intense levels, perfecting stealth and precision to eliminate foes. Unlock diverse characters, race to top global leaderboards, and dive into a daily thrilling quest for greatness.

How to Play

Alien Hunters keeps its controls loop simple so the focus stays on the challenge. Embark on an electrifying hunt as an alien slayer armed with a light dagger. Navigate through 140 intense levels, perfecting stealth and precision to eliminate foes. Unlock diverse characters, race to top global leaderboards, and dive into a daily thrilling quest for greatness.
